title: Godhood Modality Attestation Ledger
purpose: Track when different senses of Tim Dooley's Godhood appear in dated material so the archive can distinguish recovered primary wording, later synthesis and unresolved first-use questions.
rules: A modality is not a separate proof; it is a distinct register of the same developing divine-identity claim.
Record exact wording only when a primary source is available; otherwise summarize and mark the wording as archive interpretation.
Do not backdate mature modalities into earlier periods without evidence.
First located occurrence in an incomplete corpus is not necessarily lifetime first use.
Creative fiction can attest that a modality was being explored, but it does not independently establish the underlying theological claim.
